# Debian packages the setup-node-ffmpeg action installs.
#
# The apt cache key hashes this file, so editing it is what invalidates the
# cache. Each [scope] header starts a group: the ffmpeg group is installed when
# the action's ffmpeg input is true, and the playwright group when its
# playwright input is true. The key also carries the requested groups, and a
# cache miss downloads only those, so the job that needs ffmpeg never moves the
# Chromium debs and the two jobs never share or overwrite one entry.

[ffmpeg]
ffmpeg

# The Chromium system libraries behind `npx playwright install-deps chromium`
# on ubuntu-24.04-x64, copied from Playwright 1.62.0 nativeDeps so the e2e job
# can take them from the deb cache instead of running apt during install-deps.
# install-deps installs its `tools` list and its `chromium` list, so both are
# here: the fonts and X utilities first, then the libraries the browser links
# against. Refresh this list when the Playwright version moves.
[playwright]
fonts-freefont-ttf
fonts-ipafont-gothic
fonts-liberation
fonts-noto-color-emoji
fonts-tlwg-loma-otf
fonts-unifont
fonts-wqy-zenhei

xvfb

libatk1.0-0t64
libatspi2.0-0t64
